intro.t: A lawyer who *fights for the injured.*
intro.text: Mark Freeley has spent more than 30 years helping people hurt by someone else's carelessness: car crashes, construction falls, unsafe property and the loss of a loved one. He's a Hofstra Law graduate admitted in New York, New Jersey and Florida, with an office right on Main Street in Stony Brook. When he isn't in court, you'll find him volunteering and fostering for Last Chance Animal Rescue with his dogs Sarah and Saint.
intro.quote: A neighbor who shows up for people when they're hurt, and for the animals who need a second chance.

items.h: Hurt in a crash on Long Island?
items.d: Car, truck and bus accidents can leave you with medical bills, lost work and an insurance company that isn't on your side. Mark handles the claim so you can focus on getting better.
Falls from heights, scaffolding and equipment accidents. Mark has a dedicated practice for injured construction and union electrical workers.

items.h: Hurt because a property wasn't safe?
items.d: Slips, trips and falls caused by unsafe conditions at stores, homes or public places.

items.h: When a family loses someone they love.
items.d: Mark helps families who lost a loved one because of someone else's negligence, with care and patience.

advantage.text: Thirty-plus years of injury cases, a Stony Brook office on Main Street, help in English and Spanish, and a free first conversation. You talk to the lawyer, not a call center.

reviews.text: Clients trust Mark to guide them through one of the hardest times of their lives.

faq: How much does a first consultation cost?
Nothing. Mark offers a free case review. Call 631-495-9435 or send a message.
Services are offered in English and Spanish.
Throughout Nassau and Suffolk counties, with an office at 111 Main Street in Stony Brook.
What kinds of cases does he take?
Car and truck accidents, construction and workplace falls, slip and falls, unsafe property and wrongful death.

final.text: Free case review. No pressure, just answers.
